reason: ₱1,800 for one set is too much for me. At our parlor I can get gel with a simple design for around ₱500, and that's good enough even for the wedding. The free home service is nice, but I'm not paying triple just so I don't have to walk to the parlor.
objection: The price. ₱1,800 is groceries for days, and the kids are home with me anyway, so I can pop over to the parlor. I'd also want to know if a really detailed design costs more than ₱1,800.
would_change_my_mind: A promo of about ₱800 to ₱1,000, or a group rate if my sister and cousins book with me for the wedding so it comes out cheaper per person.
